$comment: Physics list to required Geant4 datasets (g4sim plan, Section 8.10), content maintained by hep-detector. From adapters/geant4/tests/g4proto/datasets/probe_datasets.py on E5, Geant4 11.4.3, 10 protons per case: a dataset is required when pointing it at an empty folder stops the run or silently changes its events. G4LEVELGAMMADATA is the silent case. FTFP_BERT__SS took the same three failures as the other lists, its other cases timed out, and its G4LEVELGAMMADATA entry follows the FTFP_BERT family. A dataset absent here was not needed by that short run, which is weaker than not needed.
